text.tspan: Annual Report of the Great Lakes Regional Water Use Database Representing 2023 Water Use Data
The data in Tables E and F and Figure E summarize the components of the Lake Michigan-Huron water
budget and the relative hydrologic effect of consumptive uses and diversions in the watershed.
Water budget average flows for the Lake Michigan-Huron basin
Because of the unique flow of the Straits of Mackinaw between lakes Michigan and Huron, the two lakes are considered as one hydrological body.
